authority: The registry is the authoritative source of tag identity. A tag is 'verified' only when it appears as a record below.
lookup_rules: A query that does not match a record returns an explicit NOT_FOUND result. The registry never returns a nearest match in place of a negative result.
A normalization candidate is a suggestion only. Offering a candidate does not verify the queried text, and does not verify the candidate for the queried text.
Status 'verified' is granted only by a registry record. It is never granted on the basis of OCR output, OCR confidence, drawing evidence or textual similarity, however high.
Alias resolution applies only to the aliases listed on a record. An unlisted alias is a NOT_FOUND, not a fuzzy match.
